items.question: What minimum age must a foreigner be at retirement to qualify for the UAE retirement residence visa?
items.gold: At least 55 years old at the time of retirement.
items.fact: Retirement visa requires being at least 55 years old.

items.question: What is the minimum annual income in AED that qualifies a retired foreigner for the UAE retirement residence visa, when not applying from Dubai?
items.gold: AED 180,000 (or its equivalent in foreign currencies), from income inside or outside the country.
items.fact: Retirement visa alternative minimum annual income is AED 180,000.
